title: Entomology's Role in the Science of Sustainability
content: Society is increasingly acknowledging the importance of “sustainability” in public discourse, and entomologists have been important contributors in providing solutions, models, and frameworks within which critical questions regarding sustainability can be explored and addressed. Entomology continues to help society discover ways to fulfill humanity’s current needs while minimizing negative impacts on the capacity of future generations to meet their own. Entomology is integral to sustainability science and policies in fields such as agriculture, environmental assessment, ecosystem services, conservation biology, human health, economics, and more.
